title: VLAN Hopping Attack
description: Harden the switch against switch spoofing and double-tagging VLAN hopping.
scenario: Harden the switch against switch spoofing and double-tagging VLAN hopping.

concepts.title: Switch Spoofing (DTP Attack)
concepts.body: An attacker sends DTP frames to negotiate a trunk with the switch. Once trunked, they can reach every VLAN. Fix: hardcode access mode and disable DTP.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# switchport mode access
SW1(config-if)# switchport nonegotiate

concepts.title: Double Tagging
concepts.body: The attacker sends a frame with two 802.1Q tags. The switch strips the first (native VLAN) tag and forwards the frame into the inner-tag VLAN — no reply path, but one-way injection works.
concepts.code:
Frame: [native tag][victim tag][data]
Switch strips native tag → forwards into victim VLAN

concepts.title: Mitigation
concepts.body: Use a dedicated unused native VLAN on all trunks, force access mode + nonegotiate on host ports, and shut down unused ports.
